name: Currentbreaker Run
introDiscord:
A permanent current races along the groove once carved by a passing
Leviathan.

Currentbreaker Sharks ride the ancient wake like it was built for them.

Technically, it was.
introTwitch:
A permanent current races along the groove once carved by a passing
Leviathan.

Currentbreaker Sharks ride the ancient wake like it was built for them.

Technically, it was.

currentbreaker-run-approach.prompt: Three paths cut through a wake current strong enough to bend wreckage.

left.message: Star Candies are pinned beneath a scale by the current.

right.message:
A Currentbreaker Shark launches through the ancient wake.

It appears to have found the express lane.

forward.message:
Behind a rib, Shizuki left a restorative bottle:

'Current tried to take backpack.

I won.

Current has one sock.

Acceptable casualty.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the bottle untouched and keep your socks secured.

currentbreaker-run-depths.prompt: The current accelerates into three racing lanes.

left.message:
A Currentbreaker Shark overtakes you.

Then loops around.

Show-off.

right.message: A navigator's chest rests inside a rare calm pocket.

forward.message:
One Berry is tied to a rock with excessive rope.

Shizuki wrote:

'Anything not tied down belongs to current.

Berry is now secured.

This may be excessive.'

currentbreaker-run-threshold.prompt: Breaker Crown rises where multiple ancient wake currents collide.

left.message:
A mineral spring bubbles behind the largest bone.

Shizuki labeled it:

'Current recovery.

Sock remains missing.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative untouched.

The sock memorial continues.

right.message:
A Currentbreaker Shark uses the colliding wakes to change direction
almost instantly.

forward.message: A wrecked strongbox has been pushed here by centuries of current.

boss-antechamber.name: Breaker Crown
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every Currentbreaker Shark abandons Breaker Crown.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every Currentbreaker Shark abandons Breaker Crown.

The ancient wake begins circling one enormous fin.

Use /yes to enter Breaker Crown or /no to leave professional current
surfing to the professionals.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every Currentbreaker Shark abandons Breaker Crown.

The ancient wake begins circling one enormous fin.

Use !yes to enter Breaker Crown or !no to leave professional current
surfing to the professionals.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat from the racing wake.

Your remaining socks survive.

boss.revealText:
A massive Shark tears through the converging currents.

Maelstrom Apex reveals itself!

completionText:
The Maelstrom Apex disappears down the ancient wake.

The current keeps racing along a path carved by a Leviathan long gone.
